source_elements_verbatim: [EP01_EL010 | 00:14.30->00:17.80] **CAMERA:** Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.
[EP01_EL011 | 00:15.50->00:17.50] **LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving):** "Gerald is waiting for me."
[EP01_EL012 | 00:17.80->00:20.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.
[EP01_EL013 | 00:18.00->00:19.40] **MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving):** "Not anymore."
[EP01_EL014 | 00:20.50->00:23.60] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.
[EP01_EL015 | 00:21.80->00:23.50] **LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading):** "What do you mean?"
[EP01_EL016 | 00:23.60->00:25.80] **CAMERA:** Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.
[EP01_EL017 | 00:23.80->00:25.50] **MATRIARCH (Dismissive):** "Look for yourself."
[EP01_EL018 | 00:25.60->00:29.80] **ACTION:** Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
[EP01_EL019 | 00:25.80->00:29.80] **CAMERA:** Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.

source_elements_verbatim: [EP05_EL001 | 00:00.00->00:02.50] **CAMERA:** Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands clutching an ancient, brass-bound leather ledger against the skirt of her white wedding gown as she walks.
